verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad remote-use tool, so scoping a connected device's permissions is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only device pairing, removing paired devices and encrypted connections, which are adjacent access controls. Clipboard sharing is documented as a feature, but nothing shows a way to limit a device to view-only, control, clipboard or file access.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
